text:
Alexandra: :wave: Heads-up: I'm drafting a one-page ops + retention playbook for Design Partners. Want input on recruitment criteria, incentives, feedback cadence, and minimal launch criteria.
Ravi: +1. Can we capture required product deliverables vs stretch items? helps scope negotiations.
Maya: Agree. Also flag data/privacy needs early (NDA, data access, logs).
Ben: Proposed recruiting tiers: 1) strategic (co-build) 2) power-users (feature feedback) 3) light testers (UX/bugs). Each has different time commitment and incentives.
Alexandra: Good. For incentives thinking: credit + early access + dedicated office hours for strategic. For power-users, swag + success story + credits.
Devon: What about success criteria? retention at 30 days, number of distinct prompts, and qualitative CSAT from weekly check-ins.
Maya: Suggest explicit exit criteria too: when to convert to paid or offboard. e.g., 3 months of regular engagement -> sales outreach.
Ben: Drafted a short onboarding cadence we can reuse:
```
Week 0: NDA + kickoff (30m)
Week 1: One-hour onboarding + integration checklist
Weeks 2-8: Biweekly feedback sessions (30m) + async survey after each release
Month 3: Review, decide convert/offboard
```
Ravi: Love that. Can we add a lightweight eval set for quality regressions? 10-15 prompts per partner, run on each candidate build.
Alexandra: Yes — link to suggested prompt template: https://go/internal/dp-prompt-template (placeholder).
ops-bot: Reminder: There's a template in product/kit/design-partner-templates.md updated today.
Devon: For tracking, simple spreadsheet columns: partner_name, tier, contacts, n_adoptions, csat, last_active, notes.
Maya: We should also add a 'risk' column (data sensitivity) and 'integration complexity'.
Ben: I'll convert cadence into a short checklist and a 1-page SLA for strategic partners. Will post later today.
Alexandra: Thanks — please @Ravi @Maya for final review before we ship to recruiting. Goal: initial list + outreach cadences by EOW. :calendar:
Ravi: I'll review tonight. quick Q: compensation band? credits tiers or per-engagement stipend?
Maya: Recommend credits for most, stipend for external enterprise customers to avoid accounting churn.
Ben: Draft invite blurb (can reuse): "Hi <Name>, we'd love to invite you as a Design Partner for Redwood's inference improvements. Expect 1 hour/month + occasional check-ins. In return you'll get priority access, credits, and a dedicated product liaison. Interested?"
Alexandra: Perfect. Small ask — keep outreach conversational not salesy. We'll iterate after first 5 replies.
Devon: +1. I'll open a recruitment spreadsheet and share.
ops-bot: Onboarding checklist created: https://go/internal/dp-onboarding-checklist (created by ops-bot).
Alexandra: Great work team. Will consolidate into the playbook and ping for approvals. :thumbsup:
